name: ARMADA
recent: Bumi Armada 在 2026 年 9 月出现大股东 Aberdeen 系机构的股权变动申报，10 月有一项未指明内容的 OTHERS 公告，11 月发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。近期没有新闻。
notable: 大股东 Aberdeen 系机构（ABRDN MALAYSIA SDN BHD、ABRDN HOLDINGS LIMITED、ABERDEEN GROUP PLC）申报股权变动。
公司发布一项未指明具体内容的 OTHERS 公告。
公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
risks: 大股东 Aberdeen 系机构出现股权变动申报，需留意后续持股变化。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 335.176 million，环比增长 9.3%，但同比下降 17.7%；净利为 MYR 70.973 million，环比增长 76.9%，同比下降 11.3%；净利率为 21.2%，高于上一季度的 13.1%。

recent_en: Bumi Armada saw substantial shareholder filings by Aberdeen-related entities in September 2026, an unspecified OTHERS announcement in October, and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 in November. There was no recent news.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder filings by Aberdeen-related entities (ABRDN MALAYSIA SDN BHD, ABRDN HOLDINGS LIMITED, ABERDEEN GROUP PLC).
The company released an OTHERS announcement without specified details.
The company released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder filings by Aberdeen-related entities; subsequent changes in shareholding should be monitored.
earnings_en: For Q2 2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 335.176 million, up 9.3% QoQ but down 17.7% YoY; net income was MYR 70.973 million, up 76.9% QoQ but down 11.3% YoY; net margin was 21.2%, higher than 13.1% in the previous quarter.
